_note: Every word a person reads in Nouride Home, written for someone who has never opened a terminal (the desktop-appliance-ui skill). {version} and {percent} are filled in; nothing else is.
off_body: Press Start, and this computer becomes the home of your AI assistant.
setting_up_body: This takes a few minutes the first time. Keep the computer on and online.
step_start: Turning Nouride on for the first time
waking_body: It will be ready in a moment.
running_body: Your assistant is ready. You can close this window: Nouride keeps running.
restarting_body: It stopped for a moment. There is nothing you need to do.
failed_body: Check that the computer is online, then try again.
install_failed_title: Nouride could not be set up
install_failed_body: Check that the computer is online, then try again.
adopted_running_body: It was already on this computer. Nouride Home opens it.
adopted_down_body: The Nouride already on this computer is turned off. Start it the way it was set up, then try again.
remote_running_body: It runs on another computer. This computer opens it.
remote_down_body: Check that the other computer is on and online, then try again.
where_body: Run it on this computer, or open a Nouride you already have on another computer, at home or in the cloud.
where_ask_body: Type the address you open it at.
where_stops_here: Nouride on this computer turns off. Its agents stop answering until you switch back to this computer in Settings.
where_plain_http: Nouride Home only opens addresses that start with https://. Try it with https://.
where_not_an_address: That doesn't look like an address. It looks like nouride.example.com.
where_unreachable: Nouride Home can't reach that address. Check it, and that the other computer is on, then try again.
nouride_update_body: Nouride {version} is ready. Your agents, chats and settings stay as they are.
connect_ready_body: On a tablet, a phone or another computer on the same network, scan this code with its camera, or type the address in its browser.
connect_qr_description: A code that opens Nouride on another device
connect_sign_in_body: Use the username and password you chose when you set up Nouride.
connect_off_body: Start it on Home, then come back here to open it on another device.
connect_no_network_title: This computer isn't on a network
connect_no_network_body: Connect it to Wi-Fi or a cable to use Nouride from a tablet or a phone.
access_body: Let a tablet, a phone or another computer on the same network open Nouride. Turn it off on a network you don't trust.
access_restarting: Nouride starts again for a moment.
this_computer_title: Only this computer can open Nouride
this_computer_body: Turn on Open from other devices to use it on a tablet, a phone or another computer.
remote_connect_body: Scan the code with a tablet's or a phone's camera, or send them the address.
remote_connect_sign_in: Sign in with that Nouride's username and password.
adopted_connect_body: Nouride was already on this computer before Nouride Home. Open it from other devices the way it was set up.
place_here_body: Nouride runs here, on this computer.
place_remote_body: This computer opens the Nouride at this address.
versions_row_update: A new version of Nouride Home is ready.
versions_row_nouride_update: A new version of Nouride is ready.
versions_row_updates: New versions of Nouride Home and Nouride are ready.
turn_off_body: Your assistant will not answer until you start it again.
check_failed: Couldn't check. Check that the computer is online, then try again.
versions_app_ready: Version {version} is ready. Nouride and your agents stay as they are.
versions_app_dev: This is a developer's build. It is never offered an update.
update_installing: Almost done. Nouride Home starts again by itself.
update_failed: The update didn't download. Check that the computer is online, then try again.
update_install_failed: The update didn't install. Try again.
versions_nouride_off: Turn Nouride on to see its version and check for updates.
versions_nouride_ready: Version {version} is ready. Your agents, chats and settings stay as they are.
versions_nouride_cannot: Nouride can't install this update by itself. Try again later.
versions_nouride_downloaded: Version {version} is downloaded and ready to install.
versions_nouride_restarting: The update is in. Nouride is starting again, which takes a minute.
versions_nouride_restarts_idle: The update is in. Nouride starts again as soon as your agents aren't busy, within ten minutes.
versions_nouride_restarts_jobs: The update is in. Nouride starts again once your agents finish their work in the background.
versions_nouride_not_ours: This Nouride was already on this computer. It updates from its own dashboard.
versions_nouride_remote: Nouride runs on another computer and updates there.
dashboard_unreachable_body: It may still be starting, or it is turned off. Check Home, then try again.
tray_update: A new version of Nouride Home is ready
access_waits: Nouride is finishing an update. Try this again in a few minutes.
where_here_body: Nouride Home installs it and keeps it running.
where_remote_body: Type the address of a Nouride you already have.
facts_others_on: Phones, tablets and other computers on this network can open Nouride.
facts_others_remote: Open it on a phone or a tablet with the code on Connect.
facts_others_adopted: Nouride was already on this computer. It opens on other devices the way it was set up.
settings_nouride_body: Turn it off when you don't need it. It stays off until you press Start on Home.
appearance_body: Nouride Home and Nouride's window look this way.
